New York Herald, 13 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br), Tibbetts, Liverpool May 31, and
Queenstown 1st inst, with mdse and 505 passengers, to John
G Dale. May 31, off Mine Head, passed steamship Kanga-
roo, bound up the Channel; 3d inst, lat 50 13, lon 25, steam-
ship City of New York, hence for Liverpool; same day, lat
49 27, lon 27 03, steamships Ericsson, Bavaria, and a Glasgow
steamer, bound E; 4th, lat 48 35, lon 32, ship Vistula, bound
E; 5th, lat 47, lon 37, bark Atlantic (Br), bound E; 7th, lat 43[?]
52, lon 47 21, steamship City of Boston, hence for Liverpool;
10th, 290 miles east of Sandy Hook, steamships Fulton, and
City of London, bound E.

claims.citation: New-York Tribune, 13 June 1866, p. 7, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br.), Tibbits, Liverpool May 31, and Queenstown
June 1, with mdse. and 505 pass. to John G. Dale. May 31, off Mine's
Head, passed s.s. Kangaroo, bound up the channel; June 3, in lat. 50
13, lon. 25, s.s. City of New-York, bound E.; same day, in lat. 49 27,
long. 27 03, steamships Ericsson, Bavaria, and a Glasgow steamship,
bound E.; 4th inst., in lat 43[?] 35, long. 32, ship Vistula, bound E.; 5th
inst., in lat. 47, long. 37, British bark Atlantic, bound E.; 7th inst., in
lat. 43 52, long. 47 21, steamship City of Boston, bound E.; 10th inst.,
290 miles east of Sandy Hook, steamships Fulton and City of London,
bound E.
